'''Jorsooda''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who was the chief rival of [[Karagga]] the Hutt.<ref name="Codex" /> Sometime between [[3645 BBY]] and [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Jorsooda had purchased three pet [[Vorantikus|vorantiki]] and bet that they could [[Death/Legends|kill]] Karagga's prized [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], [[Bonethrasher]]. The starved and crazed animals were injected with [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenals]] and released into the pit of [[Karagga's Palace]]<ref name="Codex" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]<ref name="Time" />&mdash;only to be slain by Bonethrasher within one [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]]. Karagga rewarded his pet by tossing a surprised Jorsooda into the pit as a flavorful snack.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jorsooda was mentioned in the Codex entry for Bonethrasher in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" /> The Codex entry was added to the game in [[2012]] as part of Game Update 1.1.<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20120113-0|text=Game Update 1.1: 'Rise of the Rakghouls' Coming Jan. 17th!}}</ref>
